text:
deploy-bot: Heads up — attempting to unwind runtime stickiness for model-group=llama3q in eu-north in 10m. Reason: reduce latency tail. If anyone objects or has pinned SDK/runtime clients, speak now. Command: `/deploy unstick --group=llama3q --scope=global --window=10m`

maria: Telemetry quick check: longseq p95 spikes earlier but trending down. If p95 > 800ms at start time we should hold. :eyes:

kevin: We observed a KV-cache key layout mismatch on yesterday's canary for runtime v3.2 -> some older SDK clients expect legacy key format. Unsticking runtime globally could cause silent 500s for older SDKs. Recommend we keep pin for mobile cohort until SDK shim is broadly rolled.

anita: SDK 2.8.0 (with shim) is at 20% canary now, ETA to 100% ~45m. Mobile release pipeline is slower (app store). Can we do a staged unstick by traffic tag (web first)?

sre-oncall: Rollback checklist: if we see errors >0.1% or p95 regression >200ms, plan is immediate re-pin and route fallback to regional hotspot. Runbook snippet: `/deploy pin --group=llama3q --runtime=v3.2 --reason=\"rollback\"` and revert routing policy.

devops: I can gate by region and traffic tag. Proposed sequence: eu-north (web-only) -> us-west (web-only) -> full traffic, 30m gaps. I'll add the gating job in deploy pipeline.

ops-runner: Runbook addition: monitor logs at `/logs/kvcache/llama3q` and error-rate dashboard. If KV-cache mismatch errors show up >50 in first 10m, trigger rollback.

anita: Confirming mobile clients still at 2.7.7 in the wild — ~14 active installs we saw. There's risk for that cohort.

devbot: Telemetry scan: active SDK clients by version: 2.7.7 => 14, 2.8.0-canary => 3. Flagging mobile channel as high-risk.

maria: Proposal: partial unstick for non-mobile traffic (route tag=web) only. That reduces blast radius and lets us validate end-to-end.

deploy-bot: Action scheduled: partial unstick for llama3q (scope=web-only, region=eu-north) at 1799012400. To cancel: `/deploy cancel 1799012345`. I will post status updates here.

sre-oncall: Ack. I will monitor alerts and stand by to execute rollback if needed.

devops: Adding note to release notes: "partial runtime stickiness unwind (web-only) for llama3q — monitor KV-cache errors and longseq latency".

deploy-bot: Update: executed partial unstick at 1799012400. Result: SUCCESS. No error spikes in first 5m, p95 decreased ~120ms for web traffic.

maria: Nice. Continue watching for 30m. If stable, we can schedule next region.

kevin: Before full unstick, require SDK compatibility test: `make sdk-compat-test MODEL=llama3q RUNTIME=v3.2`. Please run and share results.

ops-runner: Started compat test run at 1799012430 against sampled traffic.

devbot: Test result: sdk-compat-test PASS — sampled 2k requests, no KV mismatch observed. Completed at 1799012468.

sre-oncall: All clear from ops side. Proceed with us-west web-only after 30m gap.

deploy-bot: Noted. Scheduling next partial unstick for us-west (web-only) at 1799014200. I will update when executed.
